title: 🧹 [code health improvement description] Add support for norm vector in LoRA adapters
body:
🎯 **What:** Adds proper loading and graph-building support for normalization vectors (`_norm.weight`) in LoRA adapters.
💡 **Why:** Fixes a `TODO: add support for norm vector` in `llama-adapter.cpp`. Previously, these fully finetuned norm vectors were silently skipped. By storing them in the adapter map and applying them as a linearly scaled delta in `llama-graph.cpp`, models relying on adapted norm layers will now function correctly.
✅ **Verification:** Validated that the code compiles successfully (`cmake --build build`), verified tensor logic with unit tests via `ctest`, and successfully passed pre-commit checks and code-review to ensure no segmentation faults occur when LoRAs aren't actively used.
✨ **Result:** Adapter normalization layers are fully supported without breaking standard inference.
